title: China Points To Risk Of Clash With US After Taiwan Arms Package
description: China reiterated that US weapons sales to Taiwan raise the chances of a clash between the superpowers — underscoring its displeasure after Washington approved a deal worth up to $11 billion. The military assistance served to “put the people in Taiwan on a powder keg, push the Taiwan Strait toward danger and inevitably increase the risk of China-US conflict and confrontation,” Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing in Beijing on Friday.

title: China Menaces Japan Over Support for Taiwan
description: China has intensified pressure on Japan after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi warned of Chinese aggression toward Taiwan and reaffirmed Japan’s defensive commitments.

title: China Condemns $11 Billion US Arms Deal To Taiwan As 'Gross Violation' Of One-China Principle, Warns Against Crossing 'First Red Line'
description: China condemned the U.S. $11.15 billion arms sale to Taiwan, calling it a violation of the one-China principle, a threat to its sovereignty.

title: Rising Tensions: China's Response to U.S. Arms Sales to Taiwan
description: China's military pledges increased training and protective measures following the U.S.'s record $11.1 billion arms sale to Taiwan. This decision has further strained U.S.-China relations, with Beijing viewing the arms deal as a threat to its territorial integrity amidst its firm stance against Taiwan's independence.
